title: Voice Commit — payload
description: A sealed voice note committed by its hash, optionally offered to Hitchhiker FM. The response ($defs.Response) is the appended link.

voice.description: sha256("voice|" + iv + "|" + ct) over the note's sealed box: the note's id.

as.description: OPTIONAL. What the note is, a public word bound into the leaf. Absent means unsaid. `fortyTwo` is the Worker's `42`, the answer to the guide's question.

where.description: OPTIONAL. Which ceremony it was said in, a public word bound into the leaf. Absent means unsaid.

seconds.description: OPTIONAL. The note's length in whole seconds (the Worker's `secs`).

offer.description: OPTIONAL. Present only when the visitor offers the note to Hitchhiker FM. Absent means proof only: no audio is sent.

iv.description: The sealed box's AES-GCM initialisation vector, base64.

open.description: OPTIONAL. The open copy to be played, base64. Absent means the offer is of the sealed box only.

mediaType.description: OPTIONAL. The open copy's media type; absent means audio/webm.

seq.description: The link's sequence number on the guide's chain.

hash.description: The link's hash, folding the previous link's hash.
